stemMd: A firm reduces electricity use from 75 to 60 megawatt-hours. Production falls from 500 to 450 units. What is the new electricity use per unit relative to the old rate?
explanationMd: The ratio of intensities is (60/450)/(75/500)=8/9. Both the resource numerator and output denominator change.
